settings.startup.title: Startup
settings.startup.autostart.label: Launch NanoCrew Sync at Windows sign-in
settings.startup.autostart.sub: Reconnect mounted drives automatically. Current-user only â€” no admin rights needed.
settings.startup.startMinimized.label: Start minimized to system tray
settings.startup.startMinimized.sub: Launch into the tray on startup â€” the window stays hidden until you click the tray icon.
settings.startup.autoUpdateCheck.label: Check for updates automatically
settings.startup.autoUpdateCheck.sub: Check Cortex Labs for new releases at launch. Installs still require your confirmation.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.language.title: Language & region
settings.drives.autoMount.label: Auto-mount on startup
settings.drives.autoMount.sub: Pre-selects the auto-mount toggle for new drives added via Add Drive.
settings.drives.readonly.label: Read-only by default
settings.drives.readonly.sub: Pre-selects read-only for new drives. Prevents accidental writes.
settings.drives.perDriveOverrides.title: Per-drive overrides
settings.drives.perDriveOverrides.body: Set cache quotas, bandwidth limits, and sync schedules per drive. Individual drive settings are configured from the drive's context menu on the Drives screen.
settings.network.bandwidthDesc: Global caps in megabytes per second. Applied at chunk boundaries â€” a blank field or 0 means unlimited. Remount a drive to pick up changes.
settings.network.uploadLimit.label: Upload limit (MB/s)
settings.network.uploadLimit.sub: Throttle uploads so NanoCrew Sync doesn't saturate your connection. Decimals OK (e.g. 0.5).
settings.network.downloadLimit.label: Download limit (MB/s)
settings.network.downloadLimit.sub: Throttle range reads. Useful on metered connections.
settings.network.proxyTlsDesc: Route all S3 traffic through a corporate HTTPS proxy and/or trust an extra root CA certificate. Changes apply to new mounts and test connections â€” remount a drive to pick them up.
settings.network.proxy.label: HTTPS proxy
settings.network.proxy.sub: e.g. http://proxy.corp:8080 or http://user:pass@proxy.corp:8080. Leave blank to connect directly.
settings.network.ca.label: Custom CA certificate (PEM)
settings.network.ca.sub: Absolute path to a .pem file containing one or more trusted root certificates. Added alongside OS roots and SSL_CERT_FILE.
settings.cache.localCacheDesc: NanoCrew Sync keeps a per-drive on-disk cache of recently read byte ranges. Hits are served without touching the network; misses are fetched from S3 and written to disk for next time. The size cap is configured per drive on the Drives screen; pinned files are exempt from eviction.
settings.cache.enable.label: Enable on-disk range cache
settings.cache.enable.sub: When off, every read fetches bytes from S3 even if they're already on disk. Applies at next mount.
settings.cache.clearAll.label: Clear all cached data
settings.cache.clearAll.sub: Mounted drives will re-fetch metadata on next access.
settings.cache.locationDesc: By default, NanoCrew Sync stores its on-disk cache under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NanoCrew\Sync\cache. Override this to move the cache to a larger or faster drive. Each mounted drive gets its own subfolder. Changes apply at next mount â€” existing cached data is not migrated automatically.
settings.cache.customFolder.label: Custom cache folder
settings.cache.customFolder.sub: Absolute path. Leave blank to use the default.
settings.security.lockOnWindowsLock.sub: Re-authenticate when Windows resumes from sleep or the Win+L lock screen.
settings.security.lockOnMinimize.label: Lock app when minimized
settings.security.lockOnMinimize.sub: Require your password to unlock. Drives stay mounted â€” files stay accessible in Explorer.
settings.security.credentialStorageDesc: S3 secret keys are stored in the local SQLite database in your user app-data directory, protected by Windows file-system permissions. Your admin password is hashed with Argon2id and never stored in plaintext.
settings.notifications.mountEvents.label: Drive mounted / unmounted
settings.notifications.mountEvents.sub: Native Windows toast when a drive becomes available or is unmounted.
settings.notifications.errors.label: Errors (mount + upload)
settings.notifications.errors.sub: Surface WinFsp mount failures and upload errors as toasts.
settings.notifications.uploads.label: Upload completed
settings.notifications.uploads.sub: Off by default â€” large file transfers can get noisy.
settings.notifications.lowDisk.label: Low disk space warning
settings.advanced.verboseLogging.label: Enable verbose logging
settings.advanced.verboseLogging.sub: Writes detailed (debug-level) logs to %APPDATA%\NanoCrew\Sync\logs. Takes effect on next launch.
settings.advanced.winfspDesc: NanoCrew Sync uses WinFsp to mount cloud buckets as Windows drive letters. WinFsp is installed automatically alongside NanoCrew Sync.
settings.advanced.winfspMissingDesc: WinFsp was not found on this machine. Download and install it, then restart NanoCrew Sync. Drive mounting will not work until WinFsp is installed.
settings.advanced.crashReporting.label: Send crash reports to help improve NanoCrew Sync
settings.advanced.crashReporting.sub: No personal data or file names are collected.
